Geomystic generators dot the area, providing free power to the town. Some find the atmosphere within the town uncomfortable, saying you can literally feel the Energy being sucked from the air, but the Asura vow this enchanted technology is "perfectly safe".}} [[Rata Sum]] is the above-ground center of Asuran activity in the [[Tarnished Coast]]. ==Getting there== This [[town]] is the destination of the quest [[Lab Space]], which can be obtained from [[Vlox's Falls]]. Starting from Vlox's Falls, head west through [[Arbor Bay]] and into the [[Riven Earth]]. Continue in a westward direction to reach Rata Sum (red path). You can take an alternative route (yellow path) after arriving at Riven Earth which takes you through [[Alcazia Tangle]] and then north through [[Magus Stones]]. The alternative path is longer but allows you to skip several large groups of 5-7 [[Raptor]]s and instead face groups of [[Spider]]s and other [[Arachnid]]s. ==Quests available== *[[Blimm]] **[[Little
